question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Munificent**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stingy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Munificent"** means extremely generous or liberal in giving; lavish. (उदार, दानी)
 
 
• **Example:** The billionaire was munificent in his donations to charity, funding hospitals and schools.
 
 
• **"Stingy"** refers to someone who is unwilling to spend or give; miserly. (कंजूस)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his wealth, he was stingy and refused to contribute to any charitable cause.
